answer: A biathlon club membership with shooting range logs works as the gate: range sessions logged with one club for years. Each of 209 aliases needs its own range logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Call it the plume rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the ridge record is open for audit, and the bridge window is too short for 209 aliases to earn their price back.
